title: Meet export conditions before exporting prescribed goods
what: Goods prescribed by the export control rules may be exported only if the rules' conditions are met (such as a registered establishment, an approved arrangement or an export permit).

sources.title: Export Control Act 2020
sources.quote: 38 Exporting prescribed goods—non-compliance with prescribed export conditions—basic contravention (1) A person contravenes this subsection if: (a) the person exports goods; and (b) the goods are prescribed goods; and (c) the export of the goods is prohibited unless prescribed export conditions are complied with; and (d) prescribed export conditions were not complied with.

sources.quote: 28 Rules may prescribe goods for the purposes of this Act (1) The rules may prescribe kinds of goods (prescribed goods) for the purposes of this Act.
